ai.seo_question: Что символизируют два источника в суре Ар-Рахман?
ai.summary: В Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of the 'Two Leaders' (al-Qarain), referring to the dual forces of misguidance—often identified as Iblis and the Dajjal or the Umayyad caliphs—who lead humanity astray. The 'two fountains' (aynan) symbolize the superficial abundance and sensory allure of the worldly or intermediate realm (Barzakh) that masks the underlying spiritual deprivation. This imagery serves as a cautionary contrast to the true, eternal gardens of Paradise, emphasizing that material richness without divine proximity is ultimately illusory.
